description: Waterbergingsgebieden is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc-geoservices.bij12.nl. This national dataset contains water storage areas that provinces have designated. This dataset is used for the Nature Information Map (IKN). The IKN is an initiative of the joint provinces and offers a national and up-to-date picture of where rules apply to nature. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal shows the English title as "Water storage areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2026-02-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
